title: 餐飲服務
description: 餐飲場所的客戶服務對話

sentences.en: I made a reservation for six people under the name Johnson, and I was wondering if we could be seated near the window.
sentences.zh: 我以Johnson的名字預訂了六人位，想問我們能不能坐在靠窗的位置。

sentences.en: Could you please recommend a dish that is suitable for someone who has a severe allergy to shellfish and nuts?
sentences.zh: 您能推薦一道適合對貝類和堅果嚴重過敏的人食用的菜嗎？

sentences.en: The steak I ordered, which was supposed to be medium-rare, appears to have been cooked well beyond that specification.
sentences.zh: 我點的牛排應該是三分熟的，但看起來烹煮程度遠超過了那個標準。

sentences.en: We have been waiting for over forty minutes since placing our order, and I would appreciate an update on its status.
sentences.zh: 我們下單後已經等了四十多分鐘，希望能得到關於訂單狀態的更新。

sentences.en: I would like to speak with the manager regarding the quality of service we received during tonight's dinner.
sentences.zh: 我想就我們今晚用餐期間所受到的服務品質與經理談談。

sentences.en: Since two members of our party are vegetarian, could you indicate which items on the menu contain no animal products?
sentences.zh: 由於我們一行中有兩位素食者，您能指出菜單上哪些項目不含動物產品嗎？

sentences.en: The dessert menu, which features seasonal specialties made with locally sourced ingredients, changes on a monthly basis.
sentences.zh: 甜點菜單以當地食材製作的季節性特色菜品為特色，每月更換一次。

sentences.en: I appreciate you accommodating our large group on such short notice, especially given how busy the restaurant is tonight.
sentences.zh: 感謝您在如此臨時的情況下接待我們這麼大的團體，尤其是今晚餐廳這麼忙。

sentences.en: Could you let us know whether the chef can prepare a gluten-free version of the pasta dish listed on the specials board?
sentences.zh: 您能告訴我們廚師是否可以準備特餐板上列出的義大利麵的無麩質版本嗎？

sentences.en: The atmosphere in this restaurant, combined with the attentive staff and exquisite food, made our anniversary dinner truly memorable.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的氛圍，加上細心的服務人員和精美的食物，讓我們的周年紀念晚餐真正難忘。

sentences.en: I noticed that the bill includes a service charge, so I wanted to confirm whether an additional tip is expected or customary.
sentences.zh: 我注意到帳單包含服務費，所以我想確認是否還需要或習慣上要另外給小費。

sentences.en: Having dined here on numerous occasions, I can confidently say that the quality of the food has declined noticeably this year.
sentences.zh: 曾多次在此用餐，我可以肯定地說今年食物品質明顯下降了。

sentences.en: The waiter kindly offered to split the bill among our group, which made the payment process much more convenient for everyone.
sentences.zh: 服務員好心地提議為我們分帳，這讓大家的付款過程方便多了。

sentences.en: We would prefer a quieter table away from the kitchen entrance, if one becomes available during the course of our meal.
sentences.zh: 如果在我們用餐期間有空位的話，我們更希望坐在遠離廚房入口的安靜桌位。

sentences.en: The chef's tasting menu, consisting of seven courses paired with carefully selected wines, is available only on Friday evenings.
sentences.zh: 主廚的品嚐菜單由七道菜搭配精心挑選的葡萄酒組成，僅在週五晚間供應。

sentences.en: I am extremely disappointed that the dish contained peanuts despite my clearly stating my allergy when placing the order.
sentences.zh: 儘管我在點餐時明確說明了我的過敏情況，這道菜仍然含有花生，我非常失望。

sentences.en: Would it be possible to have the dressing served on the side, as I prefer to control the amount on my salad?
sentences.zh: 醬料可以另外放嗎？因為我喜歡自己控制沙拉上的用量。

sentences.en: The restaurant's policy, which requires a credit card to hold reservations for parties of eight or more, is clearly stated online.
sentences.zh: 餐廳的政策明確在網上說明，要求八人以上的預訂需要信用卡擔保。

sentences.en: Given that we are celebrating a special occasion tonight, I was hoping the kitchen could prepare a customized birthday cake.
sentences.zh: 鑑於我們今晚在慶祝特殊場合，我希望廚房能準備一個客製化的生日蛋糕。

sentences.en: The server informed us that the daily special, a grilled sea bass with roasted vegetables, had already sold out for the evening.
sentences.zh: 服務員告知我們今日特餐——烤鱸魚配烤蔬菜——今晚已經售完了。

sentences.en: I would like to compliment the kitchen staff on the exceptional presentation and flavor of every dish we ordered tonight.
sentences.zh: 我想讚美廚房工作人員今晚我們所點的每道菜的出色擺盤和風味。

sentences.en: Before we order, could you clarify whether the prix fixe menu allows substitutions for guests with dietary restrictions?
sentences.zh: 在我們點餐之前，您能說明固定價格菜單是否允許有飲食限制的客人替換菜品嗎？

sentences.en: The noise level in the restaurant has become quite uncomfortable, making it nearly impossible to carry on a normal conversation.
sentences.zh: 餐廳的噪音已經變得很不舒適，幾乎不可能進行正常的對話。

sentences.en: Although the food was outstanding, the extremely long wait between courses significantly diminished our overall dining experience.
sentences.zh: 雖然食物很出色，但每道菜之間極長的等待時間大大降低了我們整體的用餐體驗。

sentences.en: I am interested in booking your private dining room for a corporate event that will include approximately twenty-five guests.
sentences.zh: 我有興趣預訂你們的私人包廂，用於一場約二十五位賓客的公司活動。

sentences.en: The sommelier suggested a full-bodied red wine that pairs exceptionally well with the lamb chops we selected as our main course.
sentences.zh: 侍酒師推薦了一款醇厚的紅酒，與我們選為主菜的羊排非常搭配。

sentences.en: Could you please check with the kitchen whether they can accommodate a last-minute addition of two more guests to our reservation?
sentences.zh: 您能否與廚房確認一下，他們能否接受我們預訂臨時增加兩位客人？

sentences.en: The complimentary bread basket, served warm with herb-infused butter, is one of the thoughtful touches that keeps us coming back.
sentences.zh: 溫熱上桌並搭配香草奶油的免費麵包籃，是讓我們不斷回來的貼心之一。

sentences.en: I regret to inform you that a member of our party became ill after consuming a dish that may have contained undercooked poultry.
sentences.zh: 我很遺憾地通知您，我們一行中有人在食用了一道可能含有未煮熟禽肉的菜後生病了。

sentences.en: Since this is our first visit to your establishment, we would greatly appreciate any recommendations from the chef's seasonal selections.
sentences.zh: 由於這是我們第一次光臨貴餐廳，我們非常希望能得到主廚季節精選的推薦。
